_deal: The board's test node. This build empties it, so anything else on it leaves the board until rebuilt or restored.
author: eliza
source: his 2026-11-11 12:3x "yeah a": 28a's shape, a ship's defeat, the part out of its hold, then fitted at a second object; sk2 played first ("worked, ship hold")
_note: SHIP, HOLD, DELIVER PROBE SK3 (plan OT-37, for 28a): sk2 with a third beat. Silent, placeholder words. Not a mission.

Reading it: take it, kill the ship, loot the part (it goes to the ship's cargo). The objective moves to 'Fit the test part to the satellite', marked on a satellite at the cell's other marker. Use it: a box, the part goes, the mission pays easy.
Worth a look: the satellite should be there from the start and should not take the part before the loot (its use is gated on the loot).
